svg.title: The margin in every state and DC moved toward the Republican nominee from 2020 to 2024, by 1.0 point in Washington to 10.5 points in New York.
svg.desc: Arrows for each state and DC from the 2020 presidential margin to the 2024 margin, with the United States above them. Every arrow points toward the Republican nominee, from 1.0 point in Washington to 10.5 points in New York, and six states changed leader from the Democratic to the Republican nominee: Wisconsin, Michigan, Pennsylvania, Georgia, Nevada and Arizona. Set in Inter and Inter Tight. On a computer without both fonts, the labels fall back to another font and change width.

text.tspan: Each arrow runs from a state’s 2020 margin, at the dot, to its 2024 margin,
at the tip. The figure beside it is the shift in percentage points; this one
shows 10, at the same scale as the chart.
The scale skips from 80 to 40 points on the Democratic side so DC fits.
from the Democratic to the Republican
